OYO Parent Company Files for IPO to Raise Funds

OYO's parent company has filed preliminary documents with regulators for an Initial Public Offering (IPO). The company plans to raise approximately ₹6,650 crore through this offering. The filing includes details about the company's earnings, debt, and promoter information, as well as a separate plan by a loan-providing entity to raise ₹750 crore.
